title: GovernanceActionView
description: Source of truth: Holochain DHT (elohim DNA, Content entry, content_type LIKE 'governance-action:%', Category A per p2p-design-gate). Parent entry; vote attestations reference its CID as parentGovernanceActionCid. If this projection and the DHT disagree, the DHT wins.

id.description: CID of this governance action (content-derived identity)

dhtAnchorHash.description: ActionHash (hex) of the DHT entry — provenance anchor

subjectCid.description: CID of the entity being acted upon

eligibilityPredicateJson.description: Serialised eligibility predicate JSON, if constrained

closesAt.description: ISO 8601 close time for the voting window

parametersJson.description: Serialised additional parameters JSON, if any
